```java
@Transactional(rollbackFor = Exception.class)
public void addIncident(HttpContext context, List<Incident> incidents)
    throws ServiceException {
    if (incidents == null || incidents.isEmpty()) {
        return;
    }

    List<Event> allEvents = prepareEvents(incidents);
    persistData(incidents, allEvents);
    dispatchTasks(incidents);
}

private List<Event> prepareEvents(List<Incident> incidents) {
    List<Event> allEvents = new ArrayList<>();
    for (Incident incident : incidents) {
        List<Long> rootCsn = new ArrayList<>();
        if (incident.getEvents() != null) {
            incident.getEvents().forEach(event -> {
                event.setIncidentCsn(incident.getCsn());
                if (event.getRootEventProbability() != null && event.getRootEventProbability() > ROOT_PROBABILITY) {
                    rootCsn.add(event.getCsn());
                }
            });
            allEvents.addAll(incident.getEvents());
        }
        incident.setReasonIds(convertListToString(rootCsn));
    }
    return allEvents;
}
```

The method now validates the incidents list upfront, then delegates event extraction to a separate method that handles null event collections safely. Each incident's events are processed to identify root causes and build the complete event list.
